items.evidence: Log shows 19 µL mix, 2.5 µL fwd (A1-G1), 2.5 µL rev (A2-G2), 1 µL template from A1,A1,B1,C1,A1,A1,D1 into pcr_plate A1:G1, then 3x15 µL mix.
Log shows 19 µL water, 5 µL rCutSmart, 1 µL DpnI into A1:G1 with 3x30 µL mix; code has comments and pauses for 37/65°C incubation and Zymo clean-up (elute 20 µL).
Log shows 7 µL water, 2 µL T4 buffer, 3/2/3 µL of fragments 2/5/6, 2 µL of fragments 1,3,4,7 and 1 µL enzyme mix into A1:D1 with 5x mix after each.
Golden Gate program (30x 37/16°C, 60°C) and Zymo clean-up recorded via comment and pause; 5 µL transferred to cells A1:D1, then 250 µL LB added, with ice/heat-shock/recovery comments.
Fresh tip per primer, template and chromoprotein fragment and per assembly transfer (log pick-ups at 45-128, 339-354, 405-420); shared reagents use one tip per reagent, same as the reference.

judge.summary: The protocol simulates cleanly and its pipetting matches the specified volumes, wells and order for PCR setup, DpnI digestion, assembly, and transformation. The manual steps (thermocycling, clean-up, incubations) are recorded with comments and pauses, and tip handling matches the reference.
